input.brief_text: We need a blog article about renovating a kitchen in an old house: how to list the work and prepare to talk to a contractor. Length: 6–8 thousand characters; audience: apartment owners without construction experience. Include clear subheadings and a list of questions for the contractor. Exclude load-bearing calculations, legal advice and promises of a fixed renovation price. The text must be original, without hidden advertising. Link sources for technical facts. The budget and delivery date have not yet been agreed.
